caption: The drawing depicts a single peaked cap set against a plain, off-white background. The cap is primarily colored dark gray with a thin red piping running along the upper edge and seams. Around the base of the crown, there is a broad green band, and beneath it, a thicker yellow band with a woven texture encircles the cap. The visor is also dark gray, and a leather chin strap, fixed with a brass button, runs across the front of the cap, partially obscuring some faded yellow text which is not fully legible except for the letters "FOR." The artist's signature "ALEXANDER ANDERSON - 1932" appears faintly in small print near the lower right edge of the drawing.
title: Volunteer Fireman's Cap
